def grid_after(text, header):

    lines=text[i:].strip().splitlines()[:30]
    g=[[int(v) for v in line.split()] for line in lines]
    assert len(g)==30 and all(len(r)==30 for r in g),(header,len(g),[len(r) for r in g])
    return g

    inp=grid_after(t, f'Demo pair {i+1} input (30x30):')
    out=grid_after(t, f'Demo pair {i+1} output (30x30):')
